about.title: About Qcena
about.description: Qcena — Any Scene, Any Need. We are an Angolan platform for the showcase and sale of products, focused on bringing you good products at good prices, with simple and direct contact via WhatsApp. We select, test, and showcase quality products — you only need to get in touch and arrange delivery at a secure location near you. Qcena: today it is selling products, tomorrow it could be anything.
